traces.question: How do I file a cashless claim and what is the timeline?
traces.answer: To file a cashless claim, the Insured Person must obtain pre-authorisation from the Third Party Administrator at least forty-eight hours prior to a planned hospitalisation at a Network Provider. In case of emergency admission, intimation must be given within twenty-four hours of admission. The Company shall settle or reject a claim within thirty days of receipt of the last necessary document, and if an investigation is warranted, it shall be completed within thirty days, with the claim settled within forty-five days of receipt of the last necessary document (Clause 7).

traces.question: What are the permanent exclusions in the motor policy?
traces.answer: The permanent exclusions in the motor policy include: loss or damage caused while the vehicle is being driven by a person under the influence of intoxicating liquor or drugs (Clause 7.3, Driving Under the Influence); loss or damage caused while the vehicle is being driven by any person who is not holding an effective driving licence, or who is disqualified from holding one (Clause 7.2, Driving Without a Valid Licence); consequential loss, depreciation, wear and tear, mechanical or electrical breakdown, failures or breakages (Clause 7.1, Consequential Loss and Wear); and loss or damage arising while the vehicle is used otherwise than in accordance with the Limitations as to Use stated in the Schedule (Clause 7.4, Use Contrary to Limitations).

traces.question: Is dental treatment covered under the family health policy?
traces.answer: Dental treatment, dental surgery and orthodontic procedures of any kind are excluded from the scope of this Policy. This exclusion shall not apply where such treatment is necessitated by an accident and requires hospitalisation for at least twenty-four consecutive hours. Routine dental check-ups, scaling, polishing and cosmetic dentistry are never payable under any circumstances. Where the exception applies, the Insured Person must submit the treating dentist's report together with evidence of the accident within thirty days of discharge (Clause 4.11, Dental Treatment).

traces.question: tell me about the coverage and benefits
traces.answer: The policy provides coverage for eligible hospitalization, day-care procedures, emergency hospitalization, pre-hospitalization expenses, post-hospitalization expenses, ambulance services, and other medically necessary services, as stated in Clause 1, Policy Overview. Additionally, the policy offers a Sum Insured of INR 10,00,000 for the insured members for the policy period from 01 January 2026 to 31 December 2026, as detailed in Clause 27, Policy Summary. Claims are subject to the applicable Sum Insured, deductibles, co-payment, waiting periods, sub-limits, exclusions, medical necessity, documentation requirements, and all other conditions contained in the complete policy document.
